title: [AAPS3.0.0.1] Wear dont show forecast, although is it enabled in wear-settings
symptom: After installing AAPS 3.0.0.1 from master-branch on phone and Wear OS watch, the watch (Fossil Gen5) does not show forecast line in watch faces with graph/diagram, even though forecast is enabled in wear settings. The phone shows both regular and forecast lines, but the watch only shows regular without forecast.
fix: The issue resolved itself after the watch was charged overnight; no specific fix was identified.
evidence_quote: But today, I open my eyes and the forecast was shown.
